premises.text: Retail category managers cannot competitively price tens of thousands of SKUs quickly against many online rivals without losing profitability
premises.evidence_span: for 25,000 products every single hour. And that is a non-trivial problem

premises.text: Boomerang connects to the retailer's e-commerce platform and shows competitive positioning versus chosen competitor sites
premises.evidence_span: This is connected to my e-commerce platform

premises.text: Users can define pricing strategies that maximize revenue while maintaining margin dollars, with what-if simulation from historical data

premises.text: The company is a price optimization platform, not a mere price-comparison/matching engine

premises.text: Monetization is SaaS via monthly subscription fees
